name: Pak Tani
lore: The pioneering cultivator of District 01. Known for harvesting radiant golden eggs and keeping the district well-nourished.

name: Bu Siti
lore: Proprietor of the district's favorite bakery. Her cosmic pastries restore morale across the entire neighborhood.

name: Mas Budi
lore: The relaxed philosopher of District 01. Loves coffee, sunny courtyard afternoons, and community gatherings.

name: Dik Joko
lore: Energetic and quick on his feet, always eager to explore the outer reaches of the district.

name: Neng Ida
lore: Passionate advocate for public parks, clean energy, and equal token access.

name: Warden
lore: Staunch protector stationed at the training dojo gates. Ready to test any aspiring agent.

name: Dr. Nebu
lore: Manages atmospheric scrubbers and medical canisters across the district domes.

name: GM Crypto
lore: Greets every new visitor with a fresh cup of coffee and enthusiastic community updates.

name: Mas Rocker
lore: Provides the 8-bit chiptune soundtrack echoing from the district plaza.

name: Kapten Udara
lore: Patrols the upper stratosphere, providing aerial reconnaissance for the district.
